-- =====================================================
-- HABILIDAD ESPIA: Tablet + Nanobot con cara de camara
-- 1) Equipa la "Spy Tablet" del inventario (se abre la lista de jugadores)
-- 2) Elige un jugador: el nanobot vuela hasta su cabeza y entra en ella
-- 3) Ves por sus ojos. "Players" para cambiar de jugador, "Exit" para salir
-- =====================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if genv.SpyOff then pcall(genv.SpyOff) end

-- ===== ajustes =====
local BOT_SPEED = 70                          -- velocidad del nanobot
local BOT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255)
local FOV_SPY = 80                            -- campo de vision al espiar

local function new(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end

local fxFolder = new("Folder", {Name = "SpyFX"}, workspace)
local fov0 = workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView
local state = "idle"      -- idle / flying / entering / spying / returning
local target = nil
local tool = nil
local bot = nil
local conns = {}
local saved = nil
local hiddenOrig = {}
local hiddenChar = nil

-- ===== interfaz =====
local gui = new("ScreenGui", {Name = "SpyGui", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 999}, nil)
pcall(function() gui.Parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) end)
if not gui.Parent then pcall(function() gui.Parent = gethui() end) end
if not gui.Parent then pcall(function() gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end) end

local toastLbl = new("TextLabel", {
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 60), Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 34),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, TextWrapped = true, Visible = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "",
}, gui)
local function toast(txt, dur)
	toastLbl.Text = txt
	toastLbl.Visible = true
	task.delay(dur or 3, function()
		if toastLbl.Text == txt then toastLbl.Visible = false end
	end)
end

-- panel de la tablet (lista de jugadores)
local panel = new("Frame", {
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -150), Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 300),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 18, 28), BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, Active = true,
}, gui)
new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.04, 0)}, panel)
new("UIStroke", {Color = BOT_COLOR, Thickness = 2}, panel)
new("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "SPY TABLET",
	TextColor3 = BOT_COLOR, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16,
}, panel)
local list = new("ScrollingFrame", {
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 34), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -80), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	ScrollBarThickness = 4, BorderSizePixel = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
}, panel)
new("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)}, list)
local closeP = new("TextButton", {
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -40), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 32), Text = "Cerrar",
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40), TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, panel)

-- pantalla del espia (mientras ves por la camara)
local hud = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false}, gui)
new("UIStroke", {Color = BOT_COLOR, Thickness = 5, Transparency = 0.3}, hud)
local rec = new("TextLabel", {
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 12), Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90),
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16, Text = "",
}, hud)
local function hudBtn(text, x, color)
	return new("TextButton", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, x, 0, 12), Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 34),
		Text = text, BackgroundColor3 = color, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, hud)
end
local swBtn = hudBtn("Players", -112, Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 160))
local exitBtn = hudBtn("Exit", -16, Color3.fromRGB(170, 40, 40))
local flash = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5}, hud)

-- ===== nanobot con cara de camara =====
local function makeBot()
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	local parts = {}
	local function add(size, shape, color, neon, pos, rot, spin)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		if shape then p.Shape = shape end
		p.Size = size
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = neon and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.Metal
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Parent = m
		table.insert(parts, {part = p, size = size, pos = pos, rot = rot, spin = spin})
		return p
	end
	local CYL, BALL = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Enum.PartType.Ball
	local AX = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)   -- cilindro apuntando al frente
	local AY = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))   -- cilindro vertical
	local body = add(Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), BALL, Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 90), false, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), CFrame.new(), false)
	add(Vector3.new(0.3, 1, 1), CYL, Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16), false, Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.65), AX, false)
	add(Vector3.new(0.12, 0.6, 0.6), CYL, BOT_COLOR, true, Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.82), AX, false)
	local halo = add(Vector3.new(0.1, 2.3, 2.3), CYL, BOT_COLOR, true, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), AY, true)
	halo.Transparency = 0.4
	add(Vector3.new(0.12, 0.8, 0.12), nil, Color3.fromRGB(190, 195, 210), false, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0.1), CFrame.new(), false)
	add(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), BALL, BOT_COLOR, true, Vector3.new(0, 1.45, 0.1), CFrame.new(), false)
	m.PrimaryPart = body
	m.Parent = fxFolder

	local a0 = new("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0.6)}, body)
	local a1 = new("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.4, 0.6)}, body)
	new("Trail", {
		Attachment0 = a0, Attachment1 = a1, Lifetime = 0.35, LightEmission = 1,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(BOT_COLOR),
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)}),
	}, body)
	new("PointLight", {Color = BOT_COLOR, Range = 14, Brightness = 2}, body)
	return {model = m, parts = parts}
end

local function placeBot(b, cf, scale, t)
	for _, e in ipairs(b.parts) do
		local rot = e.rot
		if e.spin then rot = CFrame.Angles(0, t * 9, 0) * e.rot end
		e.part.Size = e.size * scale
		e.part.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(e.pos * scale) * rot
	end
end

local function flyBot(b, startPos, getDest, onDone)
	local pos = startPos
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local con
	con = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local dest = getDest()
		if not dest then
			con:Disconnect()
			onDone(false)
			return
		end
		local d = dest - pos
		local dist = d.Magnitude
		if dist < 1.2 then
			con:Disconnect()
			onDone(true)
			return
		end
		local dir = d.Unit
		pos = pos + dir * math.min(BOT_SPEED * dt, dist)
		local tt = os.clock() - t0
		local wob = Vector3.new(0, math.sin(tt * 9) * 0.5, 0)
		placeBot(b, CFrame.new(pos + wob, pos + wob + dir), 1, tt)
	end)
	table.insert(conns, con)
	return con
end

local function shrinkBot(b, pos, onDone)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local con
	con = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 0.35
		if k >= 1 then
			con:Disconnect()
			onDone()
			return
		end
		placeBot(b, CFrame.new(pos), math.max(1 - k, 0.05), os.clock())
	end)
	table.insert(conns, con)
end

local function burst(pos)
	local p = new("Part", {Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Position = pos}, fxFolder)
	local e = new("ParticleEmitter", {
		Color = ColorSequence.new(BOT_COLOR), LightEmission = 1, Rate = 0,
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8), Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 20),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
		Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)}),
	}, p)
	e:Emit(40)
	task.delay(1.5, function() p:Destroy() end)
end

-- ===== ver por los ojos del jugador =====
local function hideTarget(ch, on)
	if not ch then return end
	for _, d in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Decal") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Head" then
			if on then
				hiddenOrig[d] = d.Transparency
				d.Transparency = 1
			elseif hiddenOrig[d] ~= nil then
				d.Transparency = hiddenOrig[d]
				hiddenOrig[d] = nil
			end
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") and (d.Name == "Head" or (d.Parent and d.Parent:IsA("Accoutrement"))) then
			d.LocalTransparencyModifier = on and 1 or 0
		end
	end
end

local function freeze(on)
	local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then
		saved = nil
		return
	end
	if on then
		saved = saved or {ws = hum.WalkSpeed, jp = hum.JumpPower, jh = hum.JumpHeight}
		hum.WalkSpeed = 0
		hum.JumpPower = 0
		hum.JumpHeight = 0
	elseif saved then
		hum.WalkSpeed = saved.ws
		hum.JumpPower = saved.jp
		hum.JumpHeight = saved.jh
		saved = nil
	end
end

local function stopSpyView()

	hideTarget(hiddenChar, false)
	hiddenChar = nil
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

	cam.FieldOfView = fov0
	freeze(false)
	hud.Visible = false
end

local function getClosestPlayer()
    local closestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then

-- MIRA FIRME - CORPO MIRA / CÂMERA LIVRE (ANTI-VOID FIX)
-- ==========================================

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ========= CONFIG =========
local MAX_DISTANCE = 1500
local FOV          = 400

-- ========= ESTADO =========
local isActive = false
local target = nil
local renderName = "AimbotLock_BodyTarget"

-- ==========================================
-- 1. INTERFACE
-- ==========================================
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MenuMira"
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.2, 0)
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleButton.Text = "Mira: DESATIVADA"
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.TextSize = 18
ToggleButton.Active = true

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
UICorner.Parent = ToggleButton

-- Arrastar botão na tela
local dragging, dragInput, mousePos, framePos = false, nil, nil, nil
ToggleButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        mousePos = input.Position
        framePos = ToggleButton.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)
ToggleButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - mousePos
        ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(
            framePos.X.Scale, framePos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            framePos.Y.Scale, framePos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- 2. VERIFICAÇÕES
-- ==========================================
local function alvoVivo(char)
    if not char or not char.Parent then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

-- ==========================================
-- 3. PROCURAR NOVO ALVO (Players + NPCs)
-- ==========================================
local function encontrarNovoAlvo()
    local melhor, menorDist = nil, math.huge
    local centro = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local origem = Camera.CFrame.Position

    local lista = {}

    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            table.insert(lista, plr.Character)
        end
    end

    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
                table.insert(lista, obj)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, char in pairs(lista) do
        if char ~= LocalPlayer.Character and alvoVivo(char) then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                local dist = (origem - head.Position).Magnitude
                if dist <= MAX_DISTANCE then
                    local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - centro).Magnitude
                        if d <= FOV and d < menorDist then
                            menorDist = d
                            melhor = char
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return melhor
end

-- ==========================================
-- 4. LOOP ANTI-VOID (ROTAÇÃO SEGURA)
-- ==========================================
local function tick()
    if not alvoVivo(target) then
        target = encontrarNovoAlvo()
    end

    if target then
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not alvoVivo(myChar) then return end
        
        local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local head = target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if myRoot and head then
            -- Calcula a direção mantendo a altura Y idêntica para não inclinar o personagem
            local targetPos = head.Position
            local rootPos = myRoot.Position
            local dir = Vector3.new(targetPos.X - rootPos.X, 0, targetPos.Z - rootPos.Z)

            -- Evita cálculos zerados/inválidos quando estiver encostado no alvo ou sofrendo knockback
            if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local newCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, rootPos + dir)
                -- Aplica apenas a rotação mantendo a física da posição intacta (evita cair no void ao tomar dano/ataques)
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPos) * (newCFrame - newCFrame.Position)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 5. ATIVAR / DESATIVAR
-- ==========================================
local function ativarMira()
    print("[MIRA] Ativada!")
    RunService:BindToRenderStep(renderName, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 1, tick)
end

local function desativarMira()
    print("[MIRA] Desativada.")
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(renderName) end)
    target = nil
end

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isActive = not isActive
    if isActive then
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        ToggleButton.Text = "Mira: ATIVADA"

local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = Player:GetMouse()
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--  UI SETUP
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
ScreenGui.Name = "AdminUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local function makeDraggable(obj)
	local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
	obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = obj.Position
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			obj.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
	obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
	end)
end

-- MAIN PANEL (SQUARE)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 320) 
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -160)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", MainFrame)
MainStroke.Thickness = 3
makeDraggable(MainFrame)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", MainFrame)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "XD Admin V3"
Title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
Title.TextSize = 24
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- SCROLLING FRAME
local Scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", MainFrame)
Scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -50)
Scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 45)
Scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
Scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
Scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4

local ListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", Scroll)
ListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
ListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 15)

local Padding = Instance.new("UIPadding", Scroll)
Padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
Padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15)

-- BUTTON GRID
local GridFrame = Instance.new("Frame", Scroll)
GridFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 130) -- Adjusted height
GridFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local GridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout", GridFrame)
GridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 135, 0, 35)
GridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)

local function createStyledBtn(name, color, parent)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
	btn.Text = name
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextSize = 13
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	return btn
end

local FlyBtn = createStyledBtn("Fly", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100), GridFrame)
local NoclipBtn = createStyledBtn("Noclip", Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 255), GridFrame)
local TPBtn = createStyledBtn("Tap TP", Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255), GridFrame)


local ResetBtn = createStyledBtn("Reset", Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), GridFrame)

-- SLIDERS
local function createSlider(name, min, max, default)
	local Holder = Instance.new("Frame", Scroll)
	Holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 45)
	Holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel", Holder)
	Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Label.TextSize = 12
	Label.Text = name .. ": " .. default
	Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	local SliderFrame = Instance.new("Frame", Holder)
	SliderFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	SliderFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
	SliderFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
	Instance.new("UICorner", SliderFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

	local Bar = Instance.new("Frame", SliderFrame)
	Bar.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 4)
	Bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.5, -2)
	Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)

	local Dot = Instance.new("TextButton", Bar)
	Dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
	Dot.Position = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), -8, 0.5, -8)
	Dot.Text = ""
	Dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Instance.new("UICorner", Dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

	local val = default
	local sliding = false
	Dot.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then sliding = true end end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then sliding = false end end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if sliding and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local per = math.clamp((i.Position.X - Bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / Bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			Dot.Position = UDim2.new(per, -8, 0.5, -8)
			val = math.floor(min + (per * (max-min)))
			Label.Text = name .. ": " .. val
		end
	end)
	return function() return val end
end

local getFlySpeed = createSlider("Fly Speed", 20, 500, 60)
local getSpeed = createSlider("Walk Speed", 16, 500, 16)
local getJumpPower = createSlider("Jump Power", 50, 500, 50)
local getGravity = createSlider("Gravity", 0, 196, 196)

-- PLAYER LIST
local ListTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", Scroll)
ListTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
ListTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ListTitle.Text = "SERVER PLAYERS"
ListTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ListTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
ListTitle.TextSize = 13

local PlayerListFrame = Instance.new("Frame", Scroll)
PlayerListFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 0)
PlayerListFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local PlayerListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", PlayerListFrame)
PlayerListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)

local function updatePlayerList()
	for _, v in pairs(PlayerListFrame:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("Frame") then v:Destroy() end end
	for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= Player then
			local pEntry = Instance.new("Frame", PlayerListFrame)
			pEntry.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
			pEntry.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
			Instance.new("UICorner", pEntry).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

			local pLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", pEntry)
			pLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
			pLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
			pLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			pLabel.Text = p.DisplayName
			pLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			pLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			pLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			pLabel.TextSize = 11

			local pTP = Instance.new("TextButton", pEntry)
			pTP.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.7, 0)
			pTP.Position = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0.15, 0)
			pTP.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
			pTP.Text = "TP"
			pTP.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			pTP.TextSize = 10
			Instance.new("UICorner", pTP).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

			pTP.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	PlayerListFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, #Players:GetPlayers() * 40)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(updatePlayerList)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(updatePlayerList)
updatePlayerList()


-- APPLY PLAYER stats
local function applyPlayerSettings()
	local char = Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		-- Walk Speed
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = getSpeed()

		-- Jump Power
		humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
		humanoid.JumpPower = getJumpPower()
	end

	-- Gravity
	workspace.Gravity = getGravity()
end

local settingsConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if Player.Character then
		applyPlayerSettings()
	end
end)

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	task.wait(0.1)
	applyPlayerSettings()
end)

-- LOGIC
-- FLY
local flying = false
FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	flying = not flying
	FlyBtn.Text = flying and "Fly (ON)" or "Fly"
	local char = Player.Character
	if flying and char then
		local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", hrp)
		bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		char.Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while flying and char.Parent do
				local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local dir = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
 -- up & down
	            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
				bv.Velocity = dir.Unit * getFlySpeed()
				if dir == Vector3.new(0,0,0) then bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0) end
				bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
				task.wait()
			end
			bv:Destroy() bg:Destroy() char.Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end)
	end
end)

	end
end)

end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Tabela para guardar os IDs das animações de andar, correr, pular e idle
local locomotionIds = {}
local ultimaVelocidade = nil

-- Função para mapear as animações do sistema de movimentação do personagem
local function carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	locomotionIds = {}
	local animateScript = character:WaitForChild("Animate", 5)
	if animateScript then
		local pastasMovimento = {"idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "strafe"}
		for _, nomePasta in ipairs(pastasMovimento) do
			local pasta = animateScript:FindFirstChild(nomePasta)
			if pasta then
				for _, obj in ipairs(pasta:GetChildren()) do
					if obj:IsA("Animation") and obj.AnimationId ~= "" then
						locomotionIds[obj.AnimationId] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Conecta ao personagem para registrar IDs e monitorar novas animações
local function conectarCharacter(character)
	carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if not humanoid then return end
	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	if not animator then return end

	animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		task.wait(0.05)
		local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
		-- Aplica a velocidade salva caso uma nova animação de emote comece
		if not (animId and locomotionIds[animId]) and ultimaVelocidade then
			track:AdjustSpeed(ultimaVelocidade)
		end
	end)
end

if player.Character then
	conectarCharacter(player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(conectarCharacter)

-- Função para alterar a velocidade dos emotes tocando no momento
local function setAnimSpeed(speed)
	if not speed then return end
	ultimaVelocidade = speed

	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			if animator then

					if not (animId and locomotionIds[animId]) then
						track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	local speed = tonumber(inputBox.Text)
	if speed then
